title: North Heights Holiday Market in the Park
seo_title: North Heights Holiday Market in the Park, Joplin
description: This is the last North Heights Market of the season, where you can shop vendors selling handmade crafts, vintage finds, art, home decor, fashion, and treats, and pick up holiday gifts from local artisans. Food trucks and vendors will be on hand for lunch, with live music from local musicians and activities for kids. It takes place November 14, 2026 (Time TBD) at 610 W F Street in Joplin, MO, with the vendor line-up to be announced closer to the event.
